citation.title: Deep learning-based 3D multigrid topology optimization of manufacturable designs
citation.authors: Jaydeep Rade, Anushrut Jignasu, Ethan Herron, Ashton Corpuz, Baskar Ganapathysubramanian, Soumik Sarkar, Aditya Balu, and Adarsh Krishnamurthy
citation.version_coded: abstract only; version of record full text inaccessible

claim.primary_outcome_paraphrase: The abstract says a multigrid CNN predicts final 3D topology directly, avoiding iterative FE solves and reducing computational time; distributed training is reported to be over four times faster with similar model performance.
claim.claimed_speedup_basis: Abstract states distributed deep learning speeds training by more than 4×; this is training acceleration, not a classical TO versus ML inference factor.
claim.alternatives: Abstract also reports high-resolution 128^3 operation, over 60,000 training examples, and manufacturing checks/printed examples.

baseline.hardware_ml: GPU supercomputing cluster for distributed training (abstract)
baseline.training_time: Distributed deep learning training reported >4× faster (abstract); absolute time not stated
baseline.quality_metric: Model performance described as similar; manufacturability constraints checked
baseline.quality_gap: Similar model performance stated for distributed versus non-distributed training; no numerical gap in abstract

notes: Full text is paywalled on ScienceDirect; an author page links only to the journal page. Title/DOI search found no legitimate open full-text copy. The abstract says the dataset will be released with the paper; availability was not confirmed.
